content.title: AKU-EB announces SSC 2009 examination results
content.summary: The Aga Khan University Examination Board announced the 2009 results for the SSC Parts I and II examinations, conducted in 22 cities across Pakistan.

content.text: The Aga Khan University Examination Board announced the 2009 results for the SSC Parts I and II examinations, conducted in 22 cities across Pakistan.

Arsalanuddin of Shahwilayat Public School stood first with 91.36 per cent marks, Sabica Fatima of Habib Girls School with 91.27 per cent came second and Raaza Malja of Tameer-e-Millat School Mianwali with 91.0 per cent stood third.
This year, 17.3 per cent of the candidates earned Grade A-1 and 29.5 per cent earned Grade A.  The overall pass rate has improved from last year's 79.9 per cent to this year's 87.1 per cent.

Since its founding in 2003, AKU-EB has continued to work toward its goal of promoting conceptual understanding and critical thinking skills to prepare candidates for higher learning and success in their professional lives.

AKU-EB's commitment to preparing examinations that test application of knowledge over rote learning and its use of technology in school examinations to ensure transparency in each candidate's measure of performance is becoming a model for improving the quality of education in Pakistan.

Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education across Pakistan are now increasingly taking into consideration that extensive research and analysis is required to develop examinations that are based on agreed standards to graduate students that are able to truly apply their knowledge and, most of all, adapt to learning in any given situation. In this regard AKU-EB is collaborating with Inter Board Committee of Chairmen (IBCC) in running a comprehensive programme to upgrade six examination boards in Pakistan.
